core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghazwa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “A military expedition or campaign”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghazwa corresponds to the Arabic form غزوة (Arabic root غ ز و (gh-z-w); غزوة (Ghazwa)). Its core sense is military expedition, campaign. Ghazwa (غزوة) is Arabic for 'a military expedition or campaign'; in Islamic history it denotes a campaign in which the Prophet himself took part. The source gloss 'military raid, conquest' is a fair rendering. It is a lexical noun; its use as a female personal name is reported but uncommon.
